description: Know what your CV or resume actually proves before you apply. Paste a job post and your CV, or attach one PDF/DOCX resume. ApplyArc maps each stated requirement to exact CV evidence, shows honest gaps in an interactive Fit Report, drafts a cover letter only from verified facts, and turns the same job into interview questions with evidence-backed guidance. It never invents experience or predicts hiring outcomes. No account required.

defaultPrompt: Show which job requirements my CV can actually prove
Write a cover letter using only facts from my CV
Prepare interview questions from this job and my CV
